page_title: ETI 1-3 NIC | St Etienne v Nice 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Jerome Brisard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by St Etienne.
90+3' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to St Etienne.
90+2' St Etienne seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
88' Substitution. Evann Guessand walks off the pitch and Ali Abdi (Nice) comes on as a substitute.

86' Close! Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
83' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Marcin Bulka.
81' Melvin Bard (Nice) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the bar!
79' Here comes a substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho is given a rest as he is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
79' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Louchet (Nice) replacing Jonathan Clauss.
79' Marcin Bulka (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
77' Marcin Bulka (Nice) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

77' Ambitious effort from Augustine Boakye (St Etienne). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
74' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Eirik Horneland decides to make a substitution. Dylan Batubinsika will be replaced by Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) replaces Irvin Cardona.
69' 1 - 3 Goal! Mohamed-Ali Cho tees up Evann Guessand (Nice) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:3.

68' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.

67' That was close by Baptiste Santamaria (Nice)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
66' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Nice.
65' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
62' Here comes a substitution. Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) is brought on as a substitute for Yvann Macon.
62' Substitution. Aimen Moueffek makes his way off the pitch and Louis Mouton (St Etienne) comes on as his replacement.
62' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Pablo Rosario is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Sofiane Diop (Nice) is replacing Gaetan Laborde.
61' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

60' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Gaetan Laborde (Nice), but the defence gets it clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.

60' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.

59' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
57' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends the corner into the box, but Gautier Larsonneur intercepts it and averts the threat.
57' Evann Guessand (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Nice earn a corner.

53' Close! Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
52' 1 - 2 This is definitely not what Mickael Nade (St Etienne) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:2.
52' Nice quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

52' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Dangerous play by Dante (Nice). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.

48' Marcin Bulka was forced into action to thwart Lucas Stassin (St Etienne). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
46' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nice was in an offside position.
46' Referee Jerome Brisard blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jerome Brisard no option but to blow his whistle.
45+2' The St Etienne players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
42' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
40' The ball breaks to Yvann Macon (St Etienne) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
38' The St Etienne players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. 65:35 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
35' Moise Bombito (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jerome Brisard saw the whole situation.
32' 1 - 1 Goal! Aimen Moueffek passes the ball to the feet of Lucas Stassin (St Etienne), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:1.
30' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' Rough tackle by Moise Bombito (Nice). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
21' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
18' The St Etienne players are exchanging some short passes.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St Etienne comes to nothing.
17' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Now St Etienne have a corner.
14' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
12' St Etienne failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' He should have scored! Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. St Etienne have a corner.
11' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) makes a strong challenge and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
10' 0 - 1 That was a beautiful moment! Pablo Rosario (Nice) plants a clever header from a high rebound straight into the roof of the net, deflecting in off the crossbar.
8' Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
7' Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonathan Clauss (Nice) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

6' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Gautier Larsonneur shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
5' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
3' St Etienne are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and St Etienne will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will officiate today.
